en: A sepia-toned photograph depicts a man in a heavy coat and cap leaning against a massive, ice-covered wall or breakwater. The structure is coated with thick, natural ice formations, and another figure or object is visible atop the wall. In the distance, there appears to be a lighthouse or beacon at the end of the pier. The landscape is stark, with snow and ice dominating the scene. No visible text is present on the front of the postcard.
